card: Tier choice is a markdown side effect: make it a gate-first decision in results
tests_added: packages/contract/src/door.test.ts::tournament.results (3 cases: old results.json accepted, tier decision accepted, bad reason rejected)
guard_cases: case 7: a results.json written before this change deserializes as TournamentResults and passes validateTournamentResults (green before and after by design)
deviations_from_card: Two commits as the card's rollback says, but commit 1 also touches summary.rs (struct-literal fills only) so the workspace compiles at every commit in the shared checkout; contract commit taken under the shared-surface lock and released. Coupled files beyond write_set: packages/contract/src/door.test.ts (case 7 TS half + vocabulary check). packages/contract/src/generated/meta.ts was regenerated with no diff. CellResult.runs_with_fail / usable_runs are Option (absent = unknown in old files, never 0) rather than plain u32. Cases 1-6 were red as non-compiling (no tier_decisions / decision module) rather than as failing assertions; the old rule demonstrably picks max quality (summary.rs:754-767) regardless of cost, coverage or judge. Card revision applied: reference judge = most cells judged, ties to the higher tier; multi-tier or off-reference cells go to beside[] with reason judge_mismatch; single-judge group ranks every cell (asserted).
notes: Declared figures: MIN_EVALUATED_SHARE = 0.5 over pass+fail+not_evaluable (not_provoked excluded from the denominator, per card); tie = gap <= sqrt(se_best^2 + se_cell^2) over per-run quality shares (no se below 2 runs -> exact ties only); cost per usable stream = cell cost / usable runs, then core p50, then quality, then tier name. Directive prevent rules count as hard rules (consistent with existing rule_fails). The registry-map deviation at summary.rs:756 (simulated-audience-testing) is closed by this change; coordinator owns .ai/* so it was not edited. No console bundle change (door route untouched). Uncommitted daemon files in status are daemon-core-rpc B's.
